XYZ Corporation shows mixed financial health. While revenue grew by 20% (from $500 million to $600 million), operating costs also increased significantly (from $300 million to $400 million), keeping the operating margin stable at approximately 33%. However, the rise in the debt-to-equity ratio from 0.5 to 0.8 indicates increased financial leverage and higher risk, suggesting the company is relying more on debt to fund its operations or growth.

The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.
